note: What a server sends to say something happened that the whole match is told about. What sort of thing is named first, and the sort settles what follows.

fields.name: event
fields.note: What sort of thing happened, and so which shape follows. Each name says what the sort is sent alongside, and each note what a client shows for it; the text of a notice that carries a map is the one that map gives it.

31.name: inhibitorDied
31.note: Sent as an inhibitor falls, with that inhibitor as source and the unit credited with it as subject. A client announces that the other side's super minions now spawn, and credits the subject beside its own record of kills.

71.name: playerLeft
71.note: Sent as a player's client leaves the match, naming that player's champion as both source and subject. A client announces that the player has quit, and nothing else changes.

118.name: minionsSpawned
118.note: Sent once, as the first minions come out. A client announces that minions have spawned.

119.name: welcome
119.note: Sent once, early in a match. A client announces the welcome for the map carried.

120.name: startNoticeTwo
120.note: Sent once, after welcome. A client announces the second notice for the map carried; on map 10 that altars unlock in thirty seconds.

121.name: startNoticeThree
121.note: Sent once, early in a match on map 8, where welcome is not. On map 10 a client announces from it that minions have spawned.

127.name: nexusIdle
127.note: Sent once, alongside minionsSpawned. A client shows no notice for it.

fields.name: source
fields.note: The unit the thing is credited to, or zero where none is.

fields.name: subject
fields.note: The unit the thing happened to, or zero where none is named.

fields.name: map
fields.note: Which map it happened on. It travels only with the three sorts that carry it.

fields.name: further
fields.note: More that comes with an inhibitor falling. Zero in everything observed, and what it holds is not recorded here.
